 Getty Images Sport Bart DHanis Oct 23, 2026 10:24-05:00 Translated by Air ambulance on Bayern Munich training pitch: serious concerns for Vincent Kompany
 Bayern Munich On Friday afternoon, an air ambulance helicopter landed on Bayern Munich's training ground for Vincent Kompany, who was rushed to hospital, according to BILD. 
 Kompany had been unwell all week. A viral infection struck him last weekend, forcing him to lie down in his coach's room during and after the match against RB Leipzig (6-1). 
 After missing Bayern's training sessions on Monday and Tuesday, he left the press conference ahead of the Champions League match against Arsenal (2-2) to his assistant. 
 According to BILD, the viral infection has caused problems with 'old scar tissue', leaving Kompany, who played for Manchester City among other clubs, struggling to move around.

 The Belgian said at the press conference after the match against Arsenal: "As a coach, you always want to do everything and achieve everything. I caught a pretty nasty virus last week and, of course, I didn't listen to my body. At a certain point, my body said: Stop now!" 
 Why Kompany was taken to hospital by ambulance on Friday remains unclear. According to BILD, there are 'serious concerns' about the Bayern coach.
